title: Matterbridge Viessmann ViCare
description: matterbridge-ai-factory-viessmann-vicare v. 1.0.0 — chaudières, pompes à chaleur, chauffe-eau

clientId.title: ViCare Client ID
clientId.description: OAuth2 client id created on https://app.developer.viessmann-climatesolutions.com (reCAPTCHA disabled, redirect URI vicare://oauth-callback/everest).

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: OAuth2 refresh token obtained via the Authorization Code + PKCE flow (offline_access scope). Used to obtain access tokens automatically.

accessToken.title: Access Token (optional)
accessToken.description: Optional still-valid access token to avoid an initial refresh.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (s)
pollInterval.description: How often to refresh ViCare features. Minimum 60s to respect API rate limits.

demoMode.title: Demo Mode
demoMode.description: Create sample devices without connecting to the cloud (for previewing/testing).

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If empty, all devices are exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug logging for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Debugging only.
